name: Minted Mike

features.name: Hot Line Multipliers
features.description: Painted lines carry multipliers up to 183x on every win they touch.

features.name: Upgradeable bonus
features.description: Ink the City can upgrade to Tag and Dash, keeping Hot Line progress.

review:
Street art meets paylines: Mike paints Hot Lines across the grid to escape the cops, and Hot Line Multipliers worth up to 183x apply to every win those lines touch.

The bonus has two stages – Ink the City can upgrade to Tag and Dash, and your Hot Line progress carries over when it does. Rated 3/5, 5,000x max, RTP versions from 96.31% down to 86.36%. Great if you like multipliers that build through a bonus.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.36% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
